settings.status_note: This page takes requests, not bookings. No payment is taken here and no date is promised. You get either an offer — price, agreed pages, exclusions, delivery date — or a decline with the reason. The offer is the booking.
settings.form_intro: Tell us the site and what worries you about it. Never send passwords, API keys or payment details; this form does not ask for them and they are not needed.
settings.form_fineprint: No payment is taken. Your request is emailed to Site Builder Stack. We do not crawl the site you name as a result of this form; the review begins only after you accept an offer.
settings.success_message: Request received — this is not a booking. We reply from admin@sitebuilderstack.com, usually within a few business days, with either an offer or a decline and the reason. Nothing has been charged and no date is reserved.
settings.aside_note: Would rather do it yourself? The guides, labs and tools cover the same method free, and the two audit toolkits package it.
